intro: Lomac Gearstrip is an ambitious gnome inventor based in Tinker Town within Ironforge. Renowned for formulating the devastating NG-5 explosive, he liaises with fellow gnomish researchers operating across Kalimdor.

p: Amid the clanging gears and hissing pipes of Ironforge's Tinker Town, Lomac Gearstrip pursues the finer points of gnomish ordnance. Like many exiled gnomes who fled the tragedy at Gnomeregan, Lomac has integrated his tinkering operations directly into the dwarven capital. His workshop focuses on volatile chemical mixtures and specialized munitions designed to overcome heavily defended enemy strongholds.

Lomac's proudest contribution to modern combat engineering is the NG-5 explosive. Formulated for maximum destructive yield, the compound demands precise handling and rare chemical reagents. To refine and deploy such hazardous inventions in the field, Lomac maintains contact with old colleagues stationed in distant theaters, exchanging technical orders and dangerous supplies across the Great Sea.
